scope: WPS source interface setup and finite diagnostics; no password module edits
changes: Apply the prepared spoof source MAC only to the owned monitor. Guard each command with phy and ownership-token verification. Read back the address before Reaver starts.
Do source setup before channel verification because taking an interface down/up can affect tuning. Failures enter existing owned-resource restoration; no silent fallback or rotation.
Disabled spoofing allows empty addresses and issues no MAC-related commands.
Normal startup explicitly logs its existing per-target runtime budget. The configured 60-second default was not silently changed.
Normal and quick incomplete-result notes retain allowlisted protocol stages and the last native Trying pin candidate; recovered credentials are not added to diagnostics.
compatibility: BusyBox 1.30.1 and 1.36.1 iplink.c implement ip link set dev address/down/up. Reaver 1.6.5/1.6.6 source-address argument is an in-process address only. Existing official OpenWrt package source index covers 19.07 through 25.12. Runtime verification is mandatory; this is not certification of all drivers.
